findings.finding: Button name اجازت دیں is unquoted (every arm); “اجازت دیں” would read clearer. Same call as round-1 UR-N2. No change.

System Settings › Privacy & Security and System Settings کھولیں keep the macOS labels in English as the ur guide requires (macOS ships no Urdu UI). Values that open with a Latin run render in the document's rtl direction and the render layer's FSI isolation; no manual bidi controls (checked). Oblique کیمرے before کی, direct کیمرا elsewhere — correct.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). اسے for one device, انہیں for both — correct.

The other 8 keys are byte-identical to the values audited as mp1843-a2-ur at 99d69f364e3 (JSON key-by-key compare of git show 99d69f364e3: vs 748f4c83caf:; only blocked_hint differs in en, context and this locale); a2 verdicts on them are carried, re-run mechanically here.
